window: cumulative sums by (key,season,date) minus same-date rows, plus full prior-season (season-1) totals of same key; NaN->0
dedupe: team_states and players dedup keep first; goals/shots/mp not deduped
A_goals: period in 1-3, empty_net==True excluded (NaN kept); missing games 0
A_x: mp rows period 1-3, shotOnEmptyNet NaN->0 ==0; side by isHomeTeam==1; game not in MPG -> 0
m_v: NaN when L NaN or 0 (ratio rule)
B1_opp: opp = other team_id in deduped team_states for game; if absent NaN
B1_shots: PP shots grouped by shots.team_id == opponent; no dedupe; slot/pt NaN coords false (comparison False)
B1_xga: mp PP shots by skater-count comparison as float; shooting side opposite of T's side; is_home True=home
B2: skater's opponent from own team's team_states row (by player's team_id); skaters whose team/game not in team_states get NaN pko; output rows = all deduped non-G skater rows
combo: 1-lg_pt zero would give inf/NaN naturally (no guard)
dates: pd.to_datetime of game_date; players dates from players table game_date
